faq.question: How much does an inflatable rental cost?
faq.answer: Wow Inflatables publishes real base daily prices so customers can compare the equipment before checking a date. Delivery and applicable county sales tax are confirmed separately.

faq.question: How much does a bounce house cost?
faq.answer: $140–$265 base daily price. Standard bounce houses start at $140. Larger themed and bounce-and-slide options reach $265. See how much a bounce house costs. See bounce-house prices.

faq.question: How much does a water slide cost?
faq.answer: $170–$495 base daily price. Water-slide prices begin at $170 and rise with size, lanes, features, and the specific model. See water-slide prices.

faq.question: How much does a combo cost?
faq.answer: $185+ base daily price. Combo prices begin at $185 for the dry-only Pirate Slide and $255 for wet/dry combos, and vary by the exact bounce-and-slide unit. Book from the current catalog.

faq.question: How much does a bounce house rental cost?

faq.question: How much does a water slide rental cost?
faq.answer: Wow Inflatables water-slide base daily prices start at $170 and reach $495 for the premium options shown. Delivery and applicable county sales tax are confirmed separately.

faq.question: Do I need a generator for a bounce house?
faq.answer: Usually no generator is needed when an approved, working, dedicated outdoor GFCI outlet is close enough for the blower. Parks, remote fields, banned building power, long cord runs, or multi-unit loads often need a generator. Match power to the exact equipment list and venue rules—do not guess watts from a chart. Call 678-379-9691 after you pick gear, or read the generator guide.

faq.question: Why does the reservation ask for the event county?
faq.answer: The event county is required with the address so delivery details and applicable county sales-tax information can be confirmed for the event location.

faq.question: What does “service area” mean here?
faq.answer: Service area means the geography where Wow can typically deliver and set up for a booked rental, subject to date, equipment, and site access. It is not a guarantee for every address on every date.

faq.question: How do I check a specific address?
faq.answer: Use https://www.wowinflatables.biz/book with the complete street address and event date. Call 678-379-9691 if the venue has gates, stairs, or special power rules.
